verdict.rationale: Text was extracted from the guidance pages at coloradosos.gov/pubs/business/main.html, coloradosos.gov/biz/FileDoc.do, tax.colorado.gov and data.colorado.gov, which indicates they were fetched as readable HTML without an interstitial. The probe notes also describe tax.colorado.gov guidance as the 'open tax surface' in the crawled corpus, and the keyless data.colorado.gov GET returned HTTP 200. The mytax.colorado.gov failure was a DNS resolution error on the filing portal, not a bot wall on guidance pages. Missing for 10: an explicit probe of the coloradosos.gov guidance pages recording status code and user agent, confirmation that no CAPTCHA, WAF challenge or JS-only shell appears, and independent corroboration.
